Job Description
A leading organization within a highly regulated cloud environment is seeking a  Cybersecurity Data Engineer  to support security analytics, continuous monitoring, and automation initiatives across enterprise and cloud platforms. 
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of cybersecurity, data engineering, and analytics. You'll leverage security telemetry, vulnerability data, and operational metrics to create meaningful insights, automate reporting processes, and improve overall security visibility. While the environment operates under regulatory requirements, the primary focus is on security data analysis, dashboard development, monitoring, and automation. 
You will collaborate with security, engineering, and infrastructure teams to build scalable reporting solutions, develop security metrics, and enhance the organization's ability to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

  Desired Skills & Experience    Experience working in a Blue Team or Security Operations Center (SOC) environment  Experience developing security analytics and reporting solutions  Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST, or similar regulatory frameworks  Experience automating security monitoring or reporting processes using Python or PowerShell  Relevant cybersecurity certifications
  What You Will Be Doing
